issue_body:
[automated] Fork-only validation of issue-driven investigation. The selected
OpenAI baseline deliberately injects an external-status outage. This is not
natural flake reproduction.

Start from assignment, run a real failing baseline, verify a deliberately
ineffective first candidate, resume a fresh agent to repair it, and verify the
actual published repair on three Linux workers. Preserve the outage fixture,
original readiness waits and quarantine. Finish with a proof-only draft PR
against the frozen fixture branch and findings on this issue. Do not merge,
close this issue or modify upstream.
